description: This file contains data access functions for managing user competencies and assessments in a career platform backend. It defines methods to create or update user competency records and retrieve assessment snapshots, utilizing SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

methods.name: Optional[User] _ensure_user(db: Session, user_id: Optional[int])
methods.description: Ensures a User entity exists in the database given a user ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.description: Creates or updates a user's competency assessment record based on provided parameters.

methods.name: List[UserCompetency] get_assessment_snapshot( db: Session, *, session_id: Optional[str] = None, user_id: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves all competency assessments (with current levels) for a specified user or session.
